text:
priya: quick thread — we need a concrete ops playbook and telemetry wiring for burst guardrails before we flip Defaults to ON. want checklist + alert text today.
anya: runtime input: core signals = pool 95p latency, KV-miss-rate, token QPS vs allocated QPS, and drop/429 rate. we should correlate them in a single dashboard.
mike: infra input: metric cardinality must stay low. prefer pool-level aggregates + tenant sampling for high-volume tenants.
sam: CS: want human-readable alerts for customers and ops. examples: "pool X entering opportunistic throttleor tenant Yue to sustained QPSxceeding creditsor 10m". also want suggested mitigation steps in the alert.
kate: legal/sales: telemetry must not include customer PII. also need a short blurb for customer console about what the alert means.
anya: proposed thresholds (starter):
- Guardrail Alert A: pool_95p_latency > 2.5x baseline for 5m
- Guardrail Alert B: kv_miss_rate > 10% AND spike in token_qps > 50% for 3m
- Guardrail Alert C: sustained token_qps > reserved_rate * 4 for 15m

mike: implementation notes: emit an "opportunistic_state" event with values [GREEN, SOFT_BURST, THROTTLED, PREWARM_DISABLED] and include short tags: pool_id, tenant_sample. keeps queries cheap.
sam: incident text suggestions: 
- title: "[Burst Guardrail] Pool <id> throttling"
- body: "95p latency jumped; we reduced soft-burst to 1.2x and routed opportunistic work to pinned lanes. Affected tenants sampled in ticket. Suggested next steps: (1) check recent deploys, (2) consider temporary reserved headroom, (3) contact CS to request pilot preheat."
anya: recovery actions runtime should take automatically on alert:
1) reduce pool multiplier to safe_multiply (1.2)
2) disable preheat for the pool for 10m
3) prefer pinned lanes for new sessions
4) emit an event to oncall with diagnostics snapshot (recent tail latencies, KV hits, token QPS)

mike: ops tooling: add a single-button rollback in console that flips multiplier and creates an ops ticket. button should also record who pressed it.
kate: customer console blurb: "Burst guardrail triggered: we temporarily tightened burst allowance to protect tail latency. If you need sustained headroom, request reserved capacity or contact your CS lead." keep it 1-2 sentences.
ops-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-9999 "Burst guardrails: alerts + playbook + UI rollback" assigned to @mike
priya: decision ask: ship initial playbook with thresholds above, opportunistic_state event, and console rollback. defer tenant-level sampled traces and per-tenant billing reconciliation to GA+1. owners: anya (runtime), mike (infra + UI), sam (CS comms), kate (contract blurb).
anya: will add diagnostic snapshot payload: last 15m 95p, 99p, kv_miss_rate, token_qps trend, recent scale events. keep payload < 10 fields.
mike: will add opportunistic_state to metric stream and the console rollback button. timeline: 1 sprint for alerts + event + UI stub, 1 sprint for automated recovery actions.
sam: will draft alert text and customer blurb, and prepare CS triage runbook. include sample email to customers.
kate: will prepare the legal-safe console text and short FAQ line.
priya: final call  thumbs? tiny vote: all in favor to ship playbook + alerting + UI rollback for GA?
anya: +1
mike: +1
sam: +1
kate: +1
priya: great. i'll update roadmap entry and mark gating: GA requires alerts, opportunistic_state event, rollback button, and CS runbook. follow-up sync 4pm PT.
